items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: So he gave me the name Arnett Cobb and the Mobb

ctx.x: All right, Arnett, now we're nearly up to date. What are those other things you've got for me?

Well, I wanted to let you know when I was working at the Zanzibar in New York at 49th and Broadway -- they had a guy from the Daily News that was a critic. I can't think of Bob's last name. Maybe you would know who he was, the musical critic for the Daily News.
